windows.command: $BOARD = '${input:boardType}'; if ($BOARD -eq 'GIMBAL_BOARD') { $MCU = 'f4' } else { $MCU = 'h7' }; if ('${input:debuggerAction}' -match 'dap \(Ozone\)') { Start-Process cmd -ArgumentList "/c start ${workspaceFolder}/Debug/gbd_server/gbd_start_dap_$MCU.bat"; if (Get-Command Ozone -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Start-Process Ozone -ArgumentList "${workspaceFolder}/Debug/ozone/control-2026-$MCU.jdebug" } else { Write-Error 'Ozone executable not found in PATH. Please add your Ozone installation directory to your system PATH environment variable.' } } elseif ('${input:debuggerAction}' -match 'jlink \(Ozone\)') { if (Get-Command Ozone -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Start-Process Ozone -ArgumentList "${workspaceFolder}/Debug/ozone/control-2026-$MCU.jdebug" } else { Write-Error 'Ozone executable not found in PATH. Please add your Ozone installation directory to your system PATH environment variable.' } } elseif ('${input:debuggerAction}' -match 'dap \(Flash\)') { openocd -f Debug/config/openocd_dap_$MCU.cfg -c 'program cmake-build-debug/control-2026.elf verify reset exit' } elseif ('${input:debuggerAction}' -match 'jlink \(Flash\)') { openocd -f Debug/config/openocd_jlink_$MCU.cfg -c 'program cmake-build-debug/control-2026.elf verify reset exit' }

args: SEL="${input:debuggerAction}"; BOARD="${input:boardType}"; case "$BOARD" in GIMBAL_BOARD) MCU=f4 ;; *) MCU=h7 ;; esac; if [[ "$SEL" =~ ^dap\ \(Ozone\)$ ]]; then open -a Terminal "${workspaceFolder}/Debug/gbd_server/gbd_start_dap_$MCU.sh"; if OZONE_APP=$(ls -d /Applications/SEGGER/Ozone_V*/Ozone.app 2>/dev/null | head -n 1) && [ -d "$OZONE_APP" ]; then open -a "$OZONE_APP" --args "${workspaceFolder}/Debug/ozone/control-2026-$MCU.jdebug"; elif command -v Ozone >/dev/null 2>&1; then open -a Ozone --args "${workspaceFolder}/Debug/ozone/control-2026-$MCU.jdebug"; else echo "Ozone executable not found in PATH or Applications. Please add Ozone to PATH." >&2; exit 1; fi; elif [[ "$SEL" =~ ^jlink\ \(Ozone\)$ ]]; then if OZONE_APP=$(ls -d /Applications/SEGGER/Ozone_V*/Ozone.app 2>/dev/null | head -n 1) && [ -d "$OZONE_APP" ]; then open -a "$OZONE_APP" --args "${workspaceFolder}/Debug/ozone/control-2026-$MCU.jdebug"; elif command -v Ozone >/dev/null 2>&1; then open -a Ozone --args "${workspaceFolder}/Debug/ozone/control-2026-$MCU.jdebug"; else echo "Ozone executable not found in PATH or Applications. Please add Ozone to PATH." >&2; exit 1; fi; elif [[ "$SEL" =~ ^dap\ \(Flash\)$ ]]; then openocd -f Debug/config/openocd_dap_$MCU.cfg -c "program cmake-build-debug/control-2026.elf verify reset exit"; elif [[ "$SEL" =~ ^jlink\ \(Flash\)$ ]]; then openocd -f Debug/config/openocd_jlink_$MCU.cfg -c "program cmake-build-debug/control-2026.elf verify reset exit"; else echo "Unknown selection" >&2; exit 2; fi
